title: Titanic survivor Lucy, Lady Duff Gordon’s diamond ring sells for £150,000 after staying in family for generations
summary_full: A diamond ring belonging to Titanic survivor Lucy, Lady Duff Gordon, sold for £150,000 at auction. The ring was expected to fetch around £80,000 but achieved a much higher final price. Lady Duff Gordon wore the ring during the sinking of the Titanic, which occurred in 1912. Other Titanic memorabilia, including a rare ticket and a postcard, were also sold at the auction.
